name: Click Therapeutics

about:
Click Therapeutics was founded in 2012 in New York City by David Benshoof Klein, who recognized the profound influence of smartphones on behavior and cognition. Klein coined the term "Digital Therapeutics™" and established the company to develop, validate, and commercialize software as prescription medical treatments for patients with unmet medical needs. The venture-backed firm counts HIG, Accelmed, and Sanofi Ventures among its investors.

The company operates a multimodal, AI-enabled platform that combines neuroscience with proprietary neuromodulatory mechanisms to create prescription digital therapeutics (PDTs) and Software-Enhanced Drugs™. Its pipeline includes CT-152 (Rejoyn™), an FDA-cleared adjunctive treatment for major depressive disorder developed with Otsuka; CT-155 (Motivista) for negative symptoms of schizophrenia; AspyreRx™ for type 2 diabetes; and CT-132 for episodic migraine, all of which have received FDA authorization. Additional candidates target opioid use disorder, multiple sclerosis, atopic dermatitis, obesity, oncology, insomnia, and acute coronary syndrome. A multidisciplinary team of clinicians, researchers, and technologists drives development from discovery through pivotal trials.

Click Therapeutics serves patients, prescribing physicians, and biopharma partners across the digital therapeutics, software-as-a-medical-device, and life-sciences sectors. Its treatments are regulated by the FDA and global authorities as medical devices and are prescribed and reimbursed as drug-software combination products.

The company's stated mission is to provide global access to safe and effective prescription digital therapeutics. Its differentiators include a platform-based approach that integrates clinically proven therapies with software-driven neuromodulation, a track record of first-of-kind FDA clearances, and a commitment to rigorous clinical validation through randomized controlled trials.
